response.answer: Recent studies highlight Vietnamese migrants' transnational practices significantly influencing their political integration in Poland, with innovative approaches focusing on dual identity and community networks. Emerging trends emphasize the role of digital connectivity in maintaining ties to Vietnam while participating in Polish society.
